searchText: I'll come knocking your door looking for a job 😂 not even him will have a job I feel rather safe given that it takes many orders of magnitude more to review code than to write it now. anyways I think vibe coded clients are not a good allocation of time. building tooling is 100x better imo. if the objective is "replacing core devs", I would spend my time writing tooling for existing software as you will have to write that same tooling for vibecoded software anyways both clients + complete roadmap 😁 https://github.com/jiayaoqijia/eth2030 I'm working on this problem now. I realized the same thing and that the number one bottleneck is review, not authoring. Figuring out how to orchestrate agents to automate review in a way that doesn't miss problems, and can autonomously identify and deal with false positives. I'm optimistic this is a solvable problem with sufficient engineering. I hope you like herding goats! That is my backup plan. ~~digital~~ nomad I am getting into book binding, of course for a book that was AI generated
